Game Overview

Ranger vs Zombies is a zombie game built around become a skilled ranger in a zombie-infested world, defending human enclaves with an array of weapons and traps. Navigate diverse landscapes, manage resources wisely, and unravel the mystery behind the undead. With cooperative play and multiple endings, engage in strategic battles and immerse yourself in atmospheric storytelling.
